Author: kupciu
Description: Show Claude Code and Codex CLI usage limits on Stream Deck keys. Reads local JSONL files — no API keys, no network calls.
Name: AI Usage Limits

Actions.Name: Claude Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows Claude Code token usage for the current 5h or 7d window. Data from local JSONL files.

Actions.Name: Codex Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows Codex CLI usage for the current 5h or 7d window. Data from local session files.
